# for each

Iterate array-style table values with a scoped loop variable.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `block.for_each` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Blocks |
| Family | Iteration |
| Monaco kind | `block` |
| Format | `for <name> in <table>:` |
| Valid contexts | `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `for item in items:<br>    -- body<br>` |

## Transformation

for _, <name> in ipairs(<table>) do ... end

## Example

```lua
for item in items:
    -- body
```
